correctness.rationale: Odd DNA length forbids self reverse-complementary words; 640 eligible words split into 320 orbits; discarding internally conflicting strands leaves 260 orbit vertices. Independent reconstruction yields 4,948 conflicting pair edges. Four exhaustive binary branch leaves have 147 rational clique duals, nonnegative weights, coverage >=1 at every remaining vertex, and strict bounds 36880/1623, 436/19, 47255/2068, 597/26 (<23); the fully verified 22-pair example covers 166 distinct four-base deletions without collision. Exact BigInt rational verification reconstructed all 147 cliques, all remaining sets and the matching witness rather than relying on a verifier exit string.
